scope: Digital-source and edition dependence known before record-level collation

nodes.role: object/sign metadata and visual-evidence discovery; some visuals explicitly permission-restricted

edges.relation: drawings may be attributed to foundational edition at item level; database is not automatically independent reading witness

independence_rules: UD and its cited editions are not independent epigraphic confirmations.
TITUS and Brixhe-Lejeune-derived readings are not independent when TITUS follows that edition.
TM identity/provenance metadata can corroborate identity fields but does not independently verify a reading merely by linking the same inscription.
Two digital representations ultimately based on the same edition count as one reading lineage until an independent collation is demonstrated.
open_edges: Exact record-level lineage beyond explicitly evidenced joins remains blocked by critical-edition/TITUS access and rights-compatible systematic collation.
Broader TM discovery benchmark lineage requires record-level public metadata or source access.
Later independent editions/collations must be mapped only where directly evidenced.
